mapper.select: SELECT facility_id, facility_name, category_id, address, longitude, latitude, source, poi_id, status, create_time FROM facility WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY facility_id
SELECT facility_id, facility_name, category_id, address, longitude, latitude, source, poi_id, status, create_time FROM facility WHERE facility_id = #{facilityId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO facility(facility_name, category_id, address, longitude, latitude, location, source, poi_id, status) VALUES(#{facilityName}, #{categoryId}, #{address}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, geography::Point(#{latitude}, #{longitude}, 4326), #{source}, #{poiId}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE facility SET facility_name = #{facilityName}, category_id = #{categoryId}, address = #{address}, longitude = #{longitude}, latitude = #{latitude}, location = geography::Point(#{latitude}, #{longitude}, 4326), source = #{source}, poi_id = #{poiId}, status = #{status} WHERE facility_id = #{facilityId}
UPDATE facility SET status = 0 WHERE facility_id = #{facilityId}
mapper.select: DECLARE @point GEOGRAPHY = geography::Point(#{lat}, #{lng}, 4326); DECLARE @buf GEOGRAPHY = @point.STBuffer(#{radiusM}); SELECT facility_id, facility_name, category_id, address, longitude, latitude, source, poi_id, status FROM facility WHERE status = 1 AND location.STIntersects(@buf) = 1

DECLARE @point GEOGRAPHY = geography::Point(#{latitude}, #{longitude}, 4326); DECLARE @buf GEOGRAPHY = @point.STBuffer(#{radius});
SELECT fc.category_code AS categoryCode, fc.category_name AS categoryName, COUNT(f.facility_id) AS facilityCount FROM facility f INNER JOIN facility_category fc ON f.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE f.location.STIntersects(@buf) = 1 AND f.status = 1 GROUP BY fc.category_code, fc.category_name ORDER BY fc.category_code
